<a name="TypedBus"></a>
## type [TypedBus](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/event/typed.go#L46-L48>)

TypedBus provides a type\-safe publish/subscribe layer on top of any contracts.EventBus. It does not replace the underlying bus — it delegates to it, so typed and untyped subscribers on the same event name coexist without conflict.

The type parameter T constrains the payload for a specific event name. You typically create one TypedBus per event name:

```
type SearchResult struct { Query string; Hits int }
var searchBus = event.NewTypedBus[SearchResult](bus)

// Publisher:
searchBus.Publish(ctx, "search:result", SearchResult{Query: "go", Hits: 42})

// Subscriber:
searchBus.Subscribe(ctx, "search:result", func(e event.TypedEvent[SearchResult]) {
    fmt.Println(e.Data.Hits) // fully type-safe
})
```

```go [typed.go]
type TypedBus[T any] struct {
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

<a name="TypedBus[T].Publish"></a>
### func \(\*TypedBus\[T\]\) [Publish](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/event/typed.go#L58>)

```go [typed.go]
func (tb *TypedBus[T]) Publish(eventName string, data T)
```

Publish encodes the payload as the event Data and publishes it on the underlying bus. The raw event is still visible to wildcard subscribers and the profiler.

<a name="TypedBus[T].Subscribe"></a>
### func \(\*TypedBus\[T\]\) [Subscribe](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/event/typed.go#L68>)

```go [typed.go]
func (tb *TypedBus[T]) Subscribe(ctx context.Context, eventName string, handler TypedHandler[T]) func()
```

Subscribe registers a type\-safe handler for the given event name. The handler is only invoked when Data can be decoded as T. If decoding fails \(e.g. an untyped publisher sent a different shape\), the event is silently skipped for this handler.

Returns an unsubscribe function identical to the underlying bus.

<a name="TypedBus[T].SubscribeAll"></a>
### func \(\*TypedBus\[T\]\) [SubscribeAll](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/event/typed.go#L82>)

```go [typed.go]
func (tb *TypedBus[T]) SubscribeAll(ctx context.Context, handler TypedHandler[T]) func()
```

SubscribeAll registers a handler for the wildcard "\*" channel, but only delivers events whose payload can be decoded as T. Events with mismatched payloads are skipped silently.

<a name="TypedEvent"></a>
## type [TypedEvent](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/event/typed.go#L15-L18>)

TypedEvent is a strongly\-typed wrapper around a contracts.Event. T is the concrete payload type for a given event name.

```go [typed.go]
type TypedEvent[T any] struct {
    Name string
    Data T
}
```

<a name="TypedHandler"></a>
## type [TypedHandler](<https://github.com/gettako/tako/blob/main/internal/event/typed.go#L21>)

TypedHandler is a handler for a typed event.

```go [typed.go]
type TypedHandler[T any] func(event TypedEvent[T])
```
